hero_title:
Your OpenCore workspace,
from inspection to configuration
hero_body: Edit config.plist with Auxiliary Tools, inspect your EFI and organize official downloads in one place
card_editor: Typed plist editing with undo, automatic backups and all OpenCore sections
card_efi: Inspect file references, back up with SHA-256 and restore into a new folder
card_hardware: Read system components and see what still requires compatibility research
home_scope: Work with copies of your EFI. This app does not mount or write system partitions. The sample configuration and OHV findings require hardware-specific review
value_hint:
Data: hexadecimal bytes
Boolean: true / false
Date: ISO 8601 (UTC)
Array order is preserved
new_config_note: Empty plist created. Use the Sample.plist from your OpenCore version to configure a real EFI
saved_with_backup: Saved. Any previous file was backed up beside it
replace_container: Replace this container and remove its child items?
delete_prompt: Delete the selected item and all its child items?
snapshot_prompt: Append discovered ACPI tables, kexts and drivers? Existing entries and their order are preserved. Review the additions before saving; kext order may need adjustment
snapshot_result: Added: ACPI {ACPI}, kexts {Kernel}, drivers {UEFI}. Review and save to apply
efi_note: Inspect a copied EFI folder. Backups include a SHA-256 manifest; restoration always creates a new folder. The official ocvalidate executable must match your OpenCore version
efi_empty: Open an EFI folder or inspect the plist from Auxiliary Tools
hardware_note: OHV reads Windows CIM information without changing hardware. Its preliminary findings do not guarantee macOS compatibility. Device IDs and the target macOS version still need verification
hardware_empty: Run a scan to inspect CPU, GPU, memory, motherboard, BIOS, disks, network and audio
downloads_note: Choose a project and query its latest stable GitHub release. Files are downloaded only from the official repositories listed here. Downloads are never run automatically
downloads_empty: OpenCorePkg includes Sample.plist and ocvalidate. Official OCAT is a separate Qt application; choose its executable in Settings after extracting it
zip_only: Only ZIP assets are shown. Choose the Windows x64 asset when downloading OCAT. Compare release notes and checksums before using downloaded tools
no_assets: No ZIP assets in this release
digest_verified: SHA-256 matches the digest supplied by GitHub for this asset
digest_unavailable: The release did not provide a SHA-256 digest. The computed hash above is for local reference; upstream integrity could not be independently checked
recovery_note: Download from Apple using the bundled OpenCorePkg macrecovery tool. Board ID and MLB affect which image Apple returns; this is a recovery image, not a full offline installer. Download and chunklist verification may take several minutes
recovery_empty: Default Board ID: MacPro7,1 (from upstream macrecovery). No version-specific presets are assumed. QEMU conversion needs qemu-img.exe selected in Settings; a VMDK alone does not configure a virtual machine
conversion_complete:
Converted: {file}
Configure the VM and its bootloader separately
reports_note: Reports stay local until you export or share them. They include hardware names and device IDs, but do not include SMBIOS serials from the plist editor
settings_note: Your preferences and logs are stored in your Windows user profile. Language changes apply after restarting the application
ocat_note: Auxiliary Tools in this app is an independent CustomTkinter plist editor. The original OpenCore Auxiliary Tools (ic005k) uses Qt and can be launched separately. No upstream OCAT code is rebranded here
settings_saved: Settings saved. Restart to apply language changes
ocat_launched: Official OCAT launched. Reload the plist after making external edits
wrong_platform: You are using an inappropriate build for this operating system. This edition of OpenCore Helper requires Windows x64. Please download the edition for your system when available
choose_new_folder: Enter a NEW destination folder name
workspace_complete:
Workspace created: {file}
The sample is not ready to boot. Configure ACPI, kexts, quirks and SMBIOS for your hardware, then run the matching ocvalidate
invalid_plist: The plist could not be read or serialized: {detail}
root_dictionary: The plist root must be a dictionary
root_edit: Select a child item to edit; the root dictionary cannot be replaced
duplicate_key: A nonempty, unique dictionary key is required: {key}
select_dictionary_key: Select a dictionary key to rename
select_array_item: Select an array item to change its order
no_config: Open and save a config.plist first
external_change: This file was changed externally. Reopen it or use Save as with a new name
efi_not_found: No EFI/OC/config.plist was found in the selected folder
backup_inside_source: Save the backup outside the source folder
destination_exists: The destination already exists. Choose a new path to preserve existing files
symlink_refused: The source contains links or junctions. Use an ordinary copied EFI folder
archive_too_large: This archive exceeds the extraction limits
unsafe_archive: The archive contains unsafe, duplicate or unsupported paths
manifest_missing: This is not an OpenCore Helper backup with a SHA-256 manifest
checksum_mismatch: File size or checksum verification failed
invalid_oc_package: The archive must contain X64/EFI and Docs/Sample.plist from OpenCorePkg
tool_not_found: Executable not found: {file}. Choose its path in Settings
network_error: Unable to reach the server. Check your connection and GitHub API limits: {detail}
untrusted_download: Only HTTPS release assets from the listed upstream repositories are accepted
windows_scan_only: Hardware scanning is available only on Windows
save_before_tool: Save your changes before opening an external tool
task_running: Another task is still running. Wait for it to finish
task_running_close: A task is running. Use Cancel when available, then wait for completion before closing
cancelled: Operation cancelled; the incomplete download was discarded
invalid_recovery_parameters: Enter a valid Mac Board ID and a 17-character MLB
recovery_failed: Recovery download or chunklist verification failed. See the local log for details: {detail}
missing_path: A required path is missing or empty
identity_unconfigured: SMBIOS field is empty or still a placeholder; configure your own identity
validation_scope: These are structural and file-reference checks. Run ocvalidate from the SAME OpenCore release for schema validation; neither check proves the EFI will boot
ohv_scope: Preliminary OHV findings; no compatibility percentage or boot guarantee is inferred
ohv_architecture: This workspace targets x86-64; verify the detected architecture
ohv_amd: AMD systems need version-specific kernel patch research. No patches are applied automatically
ohv_intel: Check CPU generation, iGPU, firmware and target macOS version in the Dortania guide
ohv_nvidia: NVIDIA support depends on exact GPU architecture and macOS version: {file}. Do not assume modern macOS acceleration
ohv_device_pending: Compatibility requires checking the exact device ID and target macOS: {file}
ohv_memory: Less than 8 GiB of RAM detected; check the requirements of your target macOS version
ohv_group_pending: Driver and device compatibility research is still required
ohv_query_unavailable: Windows could not query this hardware category
smbios_note: Edit PlatformInfo/Generic or generate unique values using the official macserial from your OpenCorePkg. Choose the model for your hardware. Generated identifiers do not establish a bootable configuration
smbios_unsaved: Changes are applied to the in-memory document. Save the plist afterwards
smbios_generated: Generated. Review these values and click Apply to config.plist
invalid_smbios_model: Enter a model such as iMac19,1 or MacPro7,1
invalid_macserial_output: macserial did not return a valid serial / MLB pair
